name: Do I need to move furniture before hardwood flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move furniture before hardwood flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all furniture and personal belongings should be removed from the rooms where hardwood flooring will be installed. This allows installers unrestricted access to the work area, ensuring a smooth and efficient process. While some contractors offer furniture moving services for an additional fee, it is generally the homeowner's responsibility to clear the space before the installation crew arrives.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, all furniture and personal belongings must be removed from the installation area. This ensures clear access for the installers.
